thread:
jess_newhire: hey team — hitting a weird one on day 2. trying to `docker pull internal-registry.redwood:5000/redwood/base:latest` and it just times out. I can ssh to the bastion but not hit the 10.20.5.2 registry directly. anyone seen this? :wave:

vpn-bot: WireGuard session established for jess_newhire (peer=jess_newhire, wg0).

maddy-eng: hey jess, can you run `curl -v http://10.20.5.2:5000/v2/` and paste output? also `traceroute -n 10.20.5.2` if possible.

jess_newhire: curl gives `curl: (7) Failed to connect to 10.20.5.2 port 5000: Connection timed out`. traceroute stops at 100.64.0.1 then nothing.

sam-sre: 100.64.0.0/10 is the CGNAT range. looks like your ISP put you behind carrier NAT which changes your public source IP and breaks our registry allowlist (we allow a small set of outbound IPs).

jess_newhire: ah that explains it — my home router is an ISP-provided mesh and the public IP is weird. how do I get around this short-term?

maddy-eng: quick workaround: tunnel the registry port over the bastion. run:

```
ssh -L 5000:10.20.5.2:5000 jess@bastion.redwood.internal -N
# then on your machine:
docker pull localhost:5000/redwood/base:latest
```

that routes the registry traffic over the bastion so the traffic originates from our network (no allowlist issue).

jess_newhire: tried that — works! pulled the image. thanks so much :tada:

sam-sre: we'll add a short-term doc in infra-runbook and create an infra ticket to add a proper TLS-proxy for the registry so CGNAT users don't need tunnels. @ola-security fyi since allowlists are involved.

ola-security: thanks for the ping. please include justification in the ticket (new-hire access + CGNAT customer cases) — we prefer not to expand allowlists without review. temporary SSH tunnel is fine.

maddy-eng: fwiw if you ever see flaky connectivity with WireGuard (UDP fragmentation from mesh routers), `wg show` and lowering the MTU to 1280 on wg0 usually helps. not the root cause here but useful to know.

jess_newhire: noted — I'll keep the tunnel until infra ticket lands. can someone add the ssh-tunnel recipe to the new-hires checklist? saved my day.

deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-342: \"registry proxy for CGNAT/new-hires\" (created by sam-sre).
